1.

Now we part, yet ever remain We in Christ always one. May we the Lord faithfully follow On the path He has prepared for us, In communion with our Father And His Son, our beloved Lord, And with all who in the light Walk here to His glory!

2.

Thus in the Spirit may we walk Continually in God’s truth-light, Until we one day see each other In our Father’s blessed house. Shining in Christ’s image, Praising His love there, We shall at home with the Lord, Never, never part again.
